about: Chemistry quests (docs/loop/items/I-053/spec.md section 6; docs/loop/items/I-057/spec.md): side quests that need a discovered reaction with the right effect, not just good aim. A quest completes when a discovered spell whose effect matches `needs` lands and the world reports `event` within `radius_m` of the landing and within `window_s` seconds (default 2.5), in the quest's place (`at`, `near_m`) when one is given. A shipped spell never completes one. `live` quests run in the block world; one per world use (I-057). `line` and `line_sprout` are the objective, `hint` and `hint_sprout` name the kind of reaction it needs (never the answer), `done` is said when it is done, and `solved_by` lists example reactions that solve it (the tests check each one, and that at least one Sprout reaction's bottles can all be found in the valley).

quests.title: Melt ice with a reaction
quests.place: any ice or snow, like the ice gate in the Frozen Fields
quests.line: Chemistry quest: melt some ice with a reaction from the Bench that gives off heat.
quests.line_sprout: Chemistry quest: melt some ice with a hot reaction you found!
quests.hint: Hint: you need a reaction that gives off heat, like something burning.
quests.hint_sprout: Hint: find a hot reaction on the Bench.
quests.done: Chemistry quest done! Your reaction gave off heat and the ice melted.

quests.title: Smother the marsh gas fire with a reaction's gas
quests.place: the gas fire in the marsh hollow
quests.line: Chemistry quest: put out the gas fire in the marsh hollow with a reaction that makes carbon dioxide.
quests.line_sprout: Chemistry quest: put out the marsh fire with a gas you made!
quests.hint: Hint: you need a reaction whose only gas is carbon dioxide. It is heavier than air and smothers flames.
quests.hint_sprout: Hint: find a reaction that makes a gas that stops fires.
quests.done: Chemistry quest done! The carbon dioxide from your reaction kept oxygen away, so the gas fire went out.

quests.title: Cool the hot vent on the charcoal mound with a reaction that takes in heat
quests.place: the vent on the charcoal mound in the Frozen Fields
quests.line: Chemistry quest: light the charcoal mound, then cool its hot vent with a reaction that takes in heat.
quests.line_sprout: Chemistry quest: make the mound's hot vent cold with a cold reaction you found!
quests.hint: Hint: some reactions take in heat by themselves, so the mix gets cold. Cast Fire into the vent first to make it hot.
quests.hint_sprout: Hint: some fizzy mixes get cold all by themselves. Make the mound hot with Fire first!
quests.done: Chemistry quest done! Your reaction took in heat, so the hot vent cooled down.

quests.title: Build a wall in the river with a reaction that makes a solid
quests.line: Chemistry quest: build a wall in the river at the ford with a reaction that makes a solid.
quests.line_sprout: Chemistry quest: make a wall in the river with a reaction that makes something solid!
quests.hint: Hint: mix two clear solutions and a solid can appear. That solid builds the wall. Aim at the water.
quests.hint_sprout: Hint: some mixes turn cloudy because a solid appears. Aim at the river!
quests.done: Chemistry quest done! A solid came out of your mix and walled off the water.

quests.title: Find the hidden mark with a reaction that changes colour
quests.place: the hidden mark west of the village
quests.line: Chemistry quest: find the hidden mark near the village with a reaction that changes colour.
quests.line_sprout: Chemistry quest: find a hidden thing with a colour-change reaction!
quests.hint: Hint: a metal can coat another metal in a solution, and the colour changes. Cast it near the village.
quests.hint_sprout: Hint: some mixes change colour. Cast one near the village!
quests.done: Chemistry quest done! Your reaction's colour change showed where something was hidden.
